name: Zombie Crusher
summary:
Apocalypse is near...the earth is completely invaded by zombies...and we can only count on you!

In this fun and highly addictive game the goal is simple; get as far from the zombies while killing them from your jeep, but the game is not!

With amazing graphics and effects you will want to keep killing them until the end!
As you drive along the street horrible zombies will start appearing and chasing you. Don't let them catch you!
